mainEntity.name: How long does it take to resolve an 18-wheeler accident claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to resolve an 18-wheeler accident claim can vary significantly depending on the complexity of the case, the severity of injuries, the cooperation of insurance companies, and whether a lawsuit is filed. Some cases might settle in a few months, especially if liability is clear and injuries are not severe. Others, particularly those involving catastrophic injuries, extensive investigation, or litigation, can take several years to reach a resolution. An attorney can provide a more specific timeline after reviewing your case details.
acceptedAnswer.description: Resolution time for an 18-wheeler accident claim varies from months to several years, depending on case complexity, injury severity, insurance cooperation, and if litigation is involved.
